Title: Transfer Quiz Question of the Day!

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
Ok, so lately on the White Wolf forum, we've been having some interesting
quiz-type questions on the thread "Masters phases" on topics such as the most
master phase actions one can have during one master phase (the highest right
now is at 95 I believe). Another question was how fast you could transfer
yourself out (losing pool only via transfers) and 4 turns seems to be the
optimum. Much of that question revolved around how quickly one could bring out
Ingrid Rossler and Tarbaby Jack. Since I've had so much fun with that, I
decided to pose my own little quiz question:

Okay, we know that going 4th or 5th with an Information Highway will allow you
to transfer out a 6-cap during your first turn. With the Tomb of Ramses you can
transfer out a 7-cap. Or with the Tomb of Ramses or Zillah's Valley you can
transfer out an 8-cap on your first turn. So:

#1. Explain how you can manage to transfer out Ingrid Rossler on your first
turn. Try to see if you can do it without losing pool other than via transfers
but I'll also accept solutions that include pool loss through other means.

#2. In a similar vein, what is the largest capacity vampire you can bring out
on your first turn? (With the same suggested restrictions as #1). Right now I
can figure out how to bring a 10-cap into play on the first turn but haven't
been able to manage 11 yet.

#3. And finally, without losing pool other than via transfers, how can you
bring out a 7-cap or 8-cap during your first turn. (I'm just interested if
there are any common ways outside of Tomb or Zillah's).

So have fun and remember contrived answers are good *and* fun! Wish I could
offer a prize or something but I guess you'll just have to settle for pride...

Halcyan 2

If i am allowed to rely on other people doing weird stuff:

player 1 plays info highway, and brings out normal.

player 2 plays malk dementia, and uses normal that turn to call a
disputed territory, giving me the info highway. they then bring up
brazil.

player 3 plays Tomb III, and makes 3 transfers, putting 3 counters on
the tomb.

player 4 plays malk dementia on brazil, and calls disputed teritory
giving me the tomb.

player 5, me, plays zillahs valley on the uncontrolled vampire with
the tomb. (bringing it to 4 pool plus 3 tomb counters). i then
transfer 6 pool to it using the info highway, and the tomb gets 6 more
counters.
i now have an uncontrolled vampire with 10 pool and 9 tomb counters.
i should be able to bring up just about anyone with that.

FYI:

There is a way to take an action with <vampire X> on your first turn (which is
the fifth turn of the game) without spending any pool or taking any transfers
yourself, while (before <vampire X> takes any action) gaining 19 pool...

... for any <vampire X> (crypt card) in the game. (That is, it can be done no
matter which <vampire X> you choose.)

(19 is probably not the most one could gain - my solution doesn't involve any
of the other Methuselahs taking more than one action on their respective
turns).

Well, this one works for vampires with capacity up to 6:
Player 1 plays Succubus Club.
Player 2 influences out Normal.
Player 3 plays Malkavian Dementia, to take Normal.
Normal calls Disputed Territory, and gives the Succubus Club to Player 5.
Player 4 plays Information Highway, and influences out a 6-cap.
Player 5 makes some crazy deal, taking 29 pool and Player 4's 6-capacity
vampire away from him.

Voila!
